## 📬 Replay Lab — inject a lead

1. Open **Pick Email** and set `email_number` (1–10), or paste a full JSON payload into `custom_json`
2. Click **Execute workflow**
3. The last node shows the intake response (201 = lead created; note the lead_id!)
4. Watch the pipeline fire under **Executions**, then inspect rows in LearningLab-SQL

Seed guide: 1 hot bulk · 2 sofa+budget · 3 vague · 4 chair no-budget · 5 tiny budget
6 out-of-stock bed · 7 off-catalog · 8 vendor pitch · 9 spam · 10 gibberish

external_id is auto-rewritten to lab-<timestamp> so evals stay clean.
